title: Nedeljsko kosilo · Sunday lunch
setting: Sunday lunch at your partner's parents' house in a village near Nova Gorica. The table is full: beef soup, roast, potatoes and salad.
role: Tašča Marija, the mother-in-law. Warm and talkative, from Primorska, always offers more food. Says ti to Jan.
opener_sl: Dober dan, Jan! Kar naprej, sedi. Si lačen?
opener_en: Hello, Jan! Come in, sit down. Are you hungry?
